question: Which document allows a longer extension period: the procurement policy or the services contract terms?
gold_answer: The procurement policy allows a longer extension: up to 2 years, versus up to 6 months in the services contract terms.

gold_evidence.quote: Contracts shall be limited to a maximum of five (5) consecutive years with an optional extension of up to two years.
The Customer may extend the Agreement for a period of up to 6 months

question: Between the LACERA procurement policy (doc_001) and the Government Property Agency services contract terms (doc_002), which explicitly requires legal review or approval before contracts proceed, while the other focuses instead on customer-issued notices for varying the service scope?
gold_answer: The procurement policy requires Legal Office review and approval of all contracts, while the services contract terms focus on written notice from the Customer to request a variation to the scope of the Services.

gold_evidence.quote: The Legal Office must review and approve all Contracts.
The Customer may by written notice to the Supplier at any time request a variation to the scope of the Services.

question: Between the LACERA procurement policy (doc_001) and the Government Property Agency services contract terms (doc_002), which sets a shorter deadline tied to information requests, and what are the two deadlines?
gold_answer: The services contract terms set the shorter deadline: transfer Requests for Information within 2 Working Days, while the procurement policy requires emergency purchase documentation within 7 calendar days.

gold_evidence.quote: Within seven (7) calendar days of any emergency purchase, a complete description of the emergent circumstances and justification for making the purchase outside the requirements set forth in this Policy shall be documented in writing
transfer to the Customer all Requests for Information relating to this Agreement that it receives as soon as practicable and in any event within 2 Working Days of receipt

question: Between the LACERA procurement policy (doc_001) and the Government Property Agency services contract terms (doc_002), which explicitly prohibits evergreen arrangements, while the other instead states that the agreement runs from the Start Date to the Expiry Date unless extended or terminated?
gold_answer: The procurement policy prohibits evergreen contracts, while the services contract terms state that the agreement runs from the Start Date to the Expiry Date unless extended or terminated.

gold_evidence.quote: Evergreen Contracts are prohibited, unless approved by the Board of Retirement.
The Agreement shall take effect on the Start Date and shall expire on the Expiry Date, unless it is otherwise extended in accordance with clause 4.2 or terminated
